abilities.name: Razorgrass Blade
_curatorNotes: Skill: single Dendro hit at skillHitmark=28f, 414.72% ATK Dendro at lvl=10. Wide 130° fan-angle. 2-3 Dendro particles per cast (50% chance for 3, 0.3s ICD).
Frames: skillFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(37), ActionDash/Jump=29 ActionSwap=36. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J — N/Q default to animLen=37.
abilities.description: Whirling the discarded sword to its limit, the Traveler unleashes 1 final stroke that deals AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of them.

abilities.name: Surgent Manifestation
_curatorNotes: Burst spawns LeaLotus Lamp at burstHitmark=91f from cast (leaLotusAppear=54f after cast + initial damage at 91f). 12s duration. Per-tick burstTick[lvl=10]=144.29% ATK Dendro at 1.5s intervals.

Authored as summons[] entry with summonTick effect: interval 1.5s (gcsim ThinkInterval=90f), firstTickDelay 0 (first damage at 91f coincides with spawnsAt=91). A1/C6 EM buff ticks run separately at 0.3s (not the damage cadence).
A6 rigor 2026-07-12: summonTick interval corrected 1 → 1.5 and firstTickDelay 1 → 0 (gcsim lealotus.go: ThinkInterval=90f=1.5s; first damage at burstHitmark=91f = spawnsAt, so 0 delay).
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(58), ActionSwap=57. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — N/E/D/J default to animLen=58.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 1200f=20s). EnergyMax=80. ConsumeEnergy(2) drains 2 energy from teammates.

A1 (Lush Reaches): LeaLotus accumulates 1 stack per second on Lamp (max 12). On burst end, explodes for burstExplode[lvl] × stacks. A1 stack accumulation + on-end explosion not authored — no trigger primitive for 'on-summon-end-with-stack-multiplier'.
C6 (Hopeful Inheritance): A1 buff +30 EM to active party member during Lamp duration. Not authored — A1 stack mechanic deferred.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim traveler/common/dendro/burst.go: the Lea Lotus Lamp gadget at f54 ticks on its own.
abilities.description: Forming a LeaLotus Lamp, the Traveler deals AoE Dendro DMG to opponents and uses the LeaLotus Lamp to deal continuous Dendro DMG to opponents within an AoE for the duration.

passives.name: Verdant Overgrowth
passives.caveat: Drawn for the whole Lamp; in play it holds only while the active character stands inside its AoE.
_curatorNotes: gcsim asc.go: `a1Stack` adds one Overflowing Lotuslight per second (cap 10) while the burst status lives, and `a1Buff` re-applies `6 × stacks` EM to the active character every 0.3s while the player is inside the Lamp's area. Authored as an active-target ramping EM buff — 0 → 60 in 6/s steps — for the Lamp's life; two arms because C2 lengthens the Lamp to 15s and an effect cannot read the summon's durationModifier.
⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15 from genshin-db: the hand-written passives ('Lush Reaches', a Lamp-Spirit detonation; a 30% EM on Bloom) were invented. gcsim knows no detonation.
passives.description: Lea Lotus Lamp will obtain one level of Overflowing Lotuslight every second it is on the field, increasing the Elemental Mastery of active character(s) within its AoE by 6. Overflowing Lotuslight has a maximum of 10 stacks.

passives.name: Verdant Luxury
_curatorNotes: EM → +0.15% Razorgrass Blade DMG and +0.1% Surgent Manifestation DMG per point — damage magnitude, which the tool never draws; description-only. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry carried invented Bloom-EM text under the A1's real name.
passives.description: Every point of Elemental Mastery the Traveler possesses increases the DMG dealt by Razorgrass Blade by 0.15% and the DMG dealt by Surgent Manifestation by 0.1%.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't draw damage amounts, and this only raises how hard Razorgrass Blade and Surgent Manifestation hit.

constellations.name: Symbiotic Creeper
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go `c1cb`: 3.5 Energy once per skill cast, on the first opponent hit. Authored at the cast. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Verdant Overflow', a 3.5-Energy TEAM refund every 5s) was invented.
constellations.description: After Razorgrass Blade hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

constellations.name: Green Resilience
_curatorNotes: Authored as a durationModifiers entry on the burst's LeaLotus Lamp (12s → 15s) with its own constellation gate; the A1 ramp and the C6 bonus each carry a 15s arm for it. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Verdant Tessera') was invented.
constellations.description: Lea Lotus Lamp's duration is increased by 3s.

constellations.name: Treacle Grass
_curatorNotes: +5 Lotuslight stacks on a Lotuslight Transfiguration (gcsim `c4`). The Transfiguration — the Lamp reacting with Hydro/Electro/Pyro — is unmodelled, so the ramp keeps its 1/s cadence. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Sprouting Verdure') was invented.
constellations.description:
After the Lea Lotus Lamp triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."

constellations.name: Withering Aggregation
constellations.caveat: Drawn for the whole Lamp; in play it holds only while the active character stands inside its AoE.
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go `c6Buff`: +12% Dendro DMG re-applied to the active character inside the Lamp's area every 0.3s for its life. 15s outright — C6 is past C2, so the Lamp is always 15s here. The matching bonus for the Transfiguration element is unmodelled with the Transfiguration itself. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Hopeful Inheritance', a flat team EM tick) was invented.
constellations.description: The Dendro DMG Bonus of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the Lea Lotus Lamp is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.
